newsitem.title: KYRGYZSTAN: Second Kyrgyz oil refinery to open in February.
newsitem.headline: Second Kyrgyz oil refinery to open in February.

text.p: The former Soviet republic of Kyrgyzstan aims to open its second oil refinery by the end of next month, the presidential press service said on Thursday.

It issued a statement saying the new $18 million Kantsky refinery, located 15 km outside the Kyrgyz capital Bishkek, would process 360,000 tonnes of crude oil and gas condensate a year from Russia and neighbouring Uzbekistan.
Kyrgyzstan's largest refinery, with an annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes, was opened at the end of last year in the south of the remote, mountainous republic, which borders China.
